palette: warm maple workbench, parchment cards, brass tape lines, indigo statute chips, vermilion refusal marks, jade qualifying marks
typography: WenKai workbench headings with ruler-station plaques and stamped verdict marks
composition: a continuous stage tape with three stations above paired reversal cards, a row of three do-and-do-not benches over a rules band, and a signing desk forking into an exemption bay with an archive drawer
surface: a maple woodworking bench with fine grain stripes, brass measuring edges and ink-stamped paper cards
motion: tape stations peg themselves along the brass edge, bench cards rise in sequence with check and cross marks, and the deed sheet slides from the signing desk to its archive slot
transition: the maple grain and brass frame persist while the workbench top is rearranged
